snippet.title: RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition - Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition will officially launch on Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and XBOX series X|S on November 10, 2026.

Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/raccoin-chaos-max-edition-switch-2
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018482
XBOX series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/raccoin-coin-pusher-roguelike/9nj30nmvk83t
